intervention: Frozen JP02 action type and every nonmovement argument. V59 replaces only the destination of predicted moves before any earlier nonadministrative command in the current own turn. Eligibility uses past actual commands only, never the current family or destination.
history: Full chronological own turns from the cached actor index. One recurrent step per own turn at the first nonadministrative PRE, unavailable PREs are masked, administrative-only turns use a masked step. Every query before that anchor uses the same incoming prior-turn state. Previous descriptors end at that query PRE, and move vectors come only from the completed previous own turn. Actor-specific state, resets at 32 own turns from actor stream start.
fallback: Original JP02 destination on later within-turn queries and when V59 has no located output. All 14439 rows remain in every overall denominator. No dropping unsupported moves.
selection: One predeclared frozen dispatch; no fitted weights, temperatures, thresholds or evaluation-based routing.
success: Strict complete-command count must exceed JP02, with exact unchanged nonmovement command outcomes. Report all categories, movement false positives, continuation/change, coverage, paired groups and 2000 group bootstrap draws. This is exploratory and never automatic promotion.
probability: Decision-only destination override after JP02 joint-MAP action selection. It is not joint MAP under a new combined distribution. Do not attach the old NLL to the hybrid or claim calibration.
limits: Previously exposed five DEV groups, observed past commands, new adapter history clock and selective frame availability, first-query movement training, missing shop arguments and ambiguous targets. Group exclusion of V59 updates does not make these untouched evaluation data.
